**Rationale**: All three candidates (inv1, dom1, agg1) show `(no change)` in their harness.diff files. Direct inspection confirms they are byte-identical to the base harness in all components: harness.py, prompts/system.md, and prompts/task.md.

The four rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1, agg1) produced different final answers (33, 70, 47, 53) because the LLM returned different calculations of C(69,12) each time—sampling variance, not harness behavior. The harness code executed identically in all runs: one LLM call, prompt substitution, and extraction of the last non-empty line.

No harness edits were attempted. Without changes to analyze, no learning about component effects is available. The adoption of agg1 is mechanical (k=1 trivial case), not evidence of which output performed better.
